instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the rows of one of my methods, a saved view over my method rows, a page at a time, each row with how strictly an answer to it is checked", and give it method (The id of the saved view that is the method).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-a-method and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: A method is a saved view over the person's method rows (their files and the sections of their files, each row whole): the view's rules keep the rows, its sort orders them, and any mix of rows is a method.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: list (records:read); list-view (records:read); record:method-row (records:list).
